skill.displayName: Free AI Clothes Changer – Change Clothes in Photos with Virtual Try-On AI Technology – API-powered
skill.summary: AI clothes changer — dress a person (image 1) in the garment shown in another photo (image 2)

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ai-clothes-changer skill.
- Allows dressing a person (image 1) in clothing from another photo (image 2).
- Requires a WeShop API key (environment variable WESHOP_API_KEY).
- Three core endpoints: start a run, poll run status, and upload images.
- Supports image inputs, optional text description, and batch generation.
- Detailed security and API usage instructions included.
